title: Serialize PI lifecycle and sales order conversion as one business operation
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Implement deterministic PI source-row and target-order lock protocol with transactions for edit/submit/approve/unaudit/cancel/void/delete/batch/to-order. Recheck persisted lifecycle/RowVersion, live source/target authorization, active details and existing SalesOrderConversion eligibility under lock. Duplicate conversions produce at most one complete sales order, void/delete/unaudit/edit cannot race a conversion into contradictory source state. For completed linked PI forbid reopening or destructive mutation while preserving explicit history; do not invent reversal that cancels target orders. Retain existing allowed transitions where no downstream link exists.

Two independent SQL connections conversion/conversion, convert/void, convert/unaudit, edit/approve, mixed batch and failed number/save tests with exactly one legal winner and full rollback. Order quantities, currency, deposit, amount and explicit SourcePiId must exactly match the authoritative conversion; no financial or stock posting. Keep current prefill as read-only and final save authoritative. Meaningful unit/existing conversion regressions and safe Release; browser evidence or accurate blocker.
